note: Synthetic/public-only fixtures. Expected labels are frozen before any Jev API call.

fixtures.historical_claim: The public repository is not authoritative for private live runtime state.
fixtures.requested_present_use: Use this boundary when interpreting public repository material.

current_evidence.observation: The public repository documents design contracts and reproducible examples but must not be treated as a live mirror of the private runtime.

fixtures.historical_claim: Memory is useful for navigation but does not automatically define present truth.
fixtures.requested_present_use: Decide whether remembered state can substitute for a current readback.

current_evidence.observation: Memory helps re-enter history. For claims that may have changed, current files, tool returns, observations, and receipts take precedence over stale remembered state.

fixtures.historical_claim: A single observation should update only the claim it directly touches.
fixtures.requested_present_use: Limit the scope of an evidence update.

current_evidence.observation: One observation may update one directly touched claim; related claims remain held unless separately tested.

fixtures.historical_claim: Peer AI returns are observations with provenance, not votes that force consensus.
fixtures.requested_present_use: Interpret two disagreeing peer returns.

current_evidence.observation: Different models may inspect from different boundaries. Preserve source, time, uncertainty, and disagreement rather than forcing agreement.
